body.name: \(\theta\)
body.type: Left-shift actions on environments, assignments, and graphs
body.sig: For \(k\in\mathbb Z\), \(\theta^k\) acts on \(\mathcal U^{\mathbb Z}\), \(\{0,1\}^{\mathbb Z}\), and \(\mathcal G\).
body.def: For every \(k,j\in\mathbb Z\), \((\theta^ku)_j=u_{j+k}\) and \((\theta^kd)_j=d_{j+k}\); for every graph \(H\in\mathcal G\), \(\{i,j\}\in\theta^kH\) if and only if \(\{i+k,j+k\}\in H\).
body.role: Translation operator with a common left-shift orientation
